text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This heated two-minute battle will make
you forget the coming winter cold,
because the one you've waited for is back
for today's autumn
Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown champion, Narita Brian,
who was injured right
before the spring
Tenno Sho, is ready to race!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's overwhelmingly favored to win, but
how exactly will today's
race turn out?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting since spring! Bring out
the Brian!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She might break another record today! I
can't wait another second!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
We didn't get to train as much because of
your injury, but you're
looking good today.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
What's most important though is you've
got that same will to run.
Now's your
chance to let loose!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
What's most important though is you've
got that same will to run.
Now's your
chance to let loose!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Right...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll give it all I have.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They've turned the final corner into the
stretch! Every racer is making
a dash for
the finish!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Has Narita Brian run out of
stamina? She's being passed
by the rear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her return to racing that autumn turns out
to be unlike anything we
had imagined.
She places twelfth.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right, you're looking good. Your legs
aren't having any trouble
moving.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was afraid she might not have completely
healed yet, but she's
doing well during
training.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Okay, next, let's simulate doing the final
straight. The Japan Cup is
next—that last
part of the Tokyo Racecourse is a long
one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You want to focus on... my final sprint...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Mind if we switch to something different?
I'll do sprinting on my own
later.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Sure, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is longer than the autumn
Tenno Sho, so I want to
work on my
pacing.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Got it. Let's do some pace training then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll get to it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's the first time she's ever asked to
change the training routine.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I heard she got better... but seeing her
now...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Mayano! Training's about to start!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay! Coming right over!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Something's bothering me about how
Brian's running. It's not as
exciting as that
time at the Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Brian...

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
We asked the fans who were there in
person what they thought of
Narita Brian's
run.

text_block_list.name: TV Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Logically,
this all makes sense. She'd been
recuperating for six whole
months after all.

text_block_list.name: TV Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Exactly!
Brian will be back to her old self
by the next race!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The TV and newspapers are all saying that
her loss was 'cause of the
injury.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There's also the fact that it's incredibly
difficult to return in peak
shape after such
a long absence. Her instincts could be
temporarily dulled.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
After seeing her blow away the
competition so many times, it's easy
to
forget something so simple.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Winning a race after coming back from an
injury is no easy task. We
just need to get
her reacclimated before the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Agreed. We still have time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I can't say I'm not concerned, her
running has always topped
what I thought
she could do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But...
the idea that her hiatus was the sole
reason she lost isn't sitting
right with me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer. But I've made my choice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep running as the new me.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's the last 200 meters! "Queen of the
Amazons" Hishi Amazon is in
hot pursuit of
the lead! Narita Brian's struggling in the
final straight!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon finishes in a close second!
Narita Brian's fallen behind
and finishes
sixth!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Like the autumn Tenno Sho, it looks like
she just couldn't go the
distance in the
Japan Cup today!
